candidate.description: SIMD TEST Vault on Robinhood Chain: a TEST of the SIMD relaunch, not the real thing. The contract that pays for and owns the fees of the "SIMD TEST 2 - DO NOT BUY" token launch and splits everything it receives every 7 days, plus the 30-day claim contract for that launch's remainder. Four linked contracts, no owner, no admin, no upgrade, no paus...
